result.title: Predictive Bandit Curriculum Reinforcement Learning via Gradient-Based Sample Group Discovery
result.summary: Curriculum learning, which organizes training samples according to their learning priority, has been widely adopted in reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency. However, existing methods commonly construct curriculum units using predefined data properties and estimate their utility by simply aggregating a single proxy signal from recent training history.Such designs may group samples with different optimization effects and fail to anticipate how their utility evolves in relation to the policy. We propose Predictive Gradient-based Bandit (PGB) Curriculum, which first discovers optimization-aware learning units by clustering projected sample-level gradients. PGB then employs a lightweight temporal predictor to forecast the future utility of each unit and converts the predictions into a Boltzmann sampling distribution for adaptive data allocation. Experiments across multiple model scales and reasoning benchmarks show that PGB consistently outperforms standard GRPO, difficulty-based curricula, and history-based scheduling strategies, demonstrating improved data utilization and training efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PGB 课程学习框架：先用样本级投影梯度聚类发现「优化感知」的学习单元，再用轻量时序预测器预估各单元未来效用，并转为 Boltzmann 采样分布做自适应数据分配，在多种模型规模和推理基准上优于 GRPO 及难度、历史类课程策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「梯度聚类划分样本组 + 预测未来效用」的训练期数据分配思路，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹筛选、贡献分配与监督信号设计提供可核查线索；但该工作针对纯文本 RL 训练效率，未涉及视觉状态保留或推理期 latent 生成，与主线仅有方法层面的间接联系。
